source_snapshot.procedure: In BMC WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs, check Chassis information and detail information, then compare FRU data with ipmitool fru print.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES reads an assumed /redfish/v1/Chassis/FRU_ADP URI with curl -k and command-line credentials, projects only Manufacturer, ProductName and SerialNumber, and omits the source-required WebUI and ipmitool FRU comparison.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION correctly restores complete Redfish/IPMI/WebUI/reference correlation and no-write controls, but leaves ordinary target mapping and expected-field inputs as a decision gate even though the test is read-only.

old_problem: The proposed three-field Redfish query neither proves that the resource is the adapter FRU nor preserves the explicit WebUI-to-ipmitool comparison. The historical review identified the correct evidence model but retained Pending and human confirmation for finite Project bindings rather than parameterizing them as execution prerequisites.
disposition_reason: Discover the actual adapter identity and every IPMI FRU device before selection, bind exactly one FRU_ADP across physical/Project identity, WebUI, IPMI and available standard or OEM Redfish inventory, parse all applicable FRU areas, then compare raw and normalized fields to the approved manufacturing/BOM reference. The missing device ID, resource URI, field applicability and expected values are explicit Project configuration inputs; they do not require a new engineering decision or point-of-action approval for this read-only case.
decision_basis: XLSX row 951, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 952 were directly reviewed; the next pending identity was verified as Functionality row 952 / variant fd0bdfa22703aee1.
The source explicitly requires both the actual WebUI Inventory and LEDs view and `ipmitool fru print`; a Redfish-only substitute or three selected properties would regress coverage.

The IPMI FRU definition separates common header, internal-use, chassis, board, product and multi-record areas and supplies identity/manufacturing fields. Applicable areas and fields therefore require an explicit field matrix rather than a generic readable-output check.

DMTF Redfish Assembly exposes assembly identity such as part number, serial number, manufacturer, production date and original-data access, but a target can expose FRU data through Chassis, Assembly or documented OEM resources. The URI must be discovered and mapped, not guessed.

ED-02, ED-08, ED-17, ED-19, ED-21 and ED-30 preserve source identity, actual visual evidence, audit evidence and independent coverage; ED-33 through ED-38 permit parameterized read-only execution while prohibiting partial-interface substitution and guessed OEM mappings.

test_case.test_name: Validate FRU_ADP identity and complete WebUI/IPMI/Redfish field parity
test_case.purpose: Verify that the selected adapter is exactly the Project-defined FRU_ADP, its complete applicable FRU contents are readable and structurally valid, and every authoritative identity/manufacturing field agrees across `ipmitool fru print`, the actual BMC WebUI Inventory and LEDs detail, the approved Project reference and any mapped Redfish standard/OEM representation without changing FRU or BMC state.
required_package: Immutable SUT/BMC/platform/adapter identity, trusted TLS chain, protected read-only Redfish/WebUI/IPMI credentials and sensitive serial/asset redaction policy
Approved FRU_ADP physical-to-logical mapping, IPMI interface/channel/bridge parameters and enumerated FRU device ID; FRU ID 0 must not be assumed
Service-root-discovered Chassis/Assembly or vendor-approved OEM inventory mapping for FRU_ADP, including supported schema/firmware versions and freshness behavior
Approved FRU area/field applicability matrix covering chassis, board, product and multi-record areas as applicable, plus encoding, padding, blank, Not Specified, unsupported and truncation rules
Authoritative manufacturing/BOM/asset reference with expected manufacturer, product/name, part/model, version, serial, asset tag, manufacture date, FRU file ID and other Project-required fields
Actual WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs row/detail mapping, visual-capture method, field labels, refresh tolerance and evidence location
test_case.test_command: READ ONLY. Verify the immutable target, enumerate the complete IPMI FRU inventory with the approved protected interface/channel and record every returned FRU device ID/name before selecting the uniquely mapped FRU_ADP. Run only `ipmitool ... fru print <approved-FRU-ID>` for that device and retain complete output and exit status. Discover standard Chassis/Assembly links or the approved OEM inventory resource from the Redfish service rather than assuming `/redfish/v1/Chassis/FRU_ADP`; retrieve the complete mapped record with certificate verification and protected credentials. Open the actual BMC WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs page, select the mapped FRU_ADP row/detail and capture the whole applicable table/detail visually. Parse and compare all applicable chassis, board, product and multi-record identity/manufacturing fields, retaining raw values and normalized values for encoding, padding, blank/Not Specified and timestamp freshness. Compare each field with the approved Project reference and reconcile WebUI, IPMI and Redfish representations. Repeat only read-only fingerprints. Do not run `fru write`, `fru edit`, `fru upgEkey`, raw storage writes, log clearing, reset, reboot or power actions.
test_case.expected_result: Exactly one enumerated IPMI FRU device and one approved WebUI/Redfish representation map to the physical FRU_ADP. Every applicable FRU area parses successfully; any tool-reported header/area/checksum or decoding error is absent. All required fields are present or carry their explicitly approved blank/unsupported representation and match the authoritative reference after documented normalization, while WebUI, IPMI and Redfish raw values remain traceable. No missing, duplicate, stale, cross-device or unexplained conflicting record exists, and pre/post evidence shows no FRU, BMC, log, reset or power change.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires unique FRU_ADP mapping, complete `ipmitool fru print` output, actual WebUI visual evidence, complete applicable-field comparison, valid parse/checksum status where reported and exact agreement with the approved reference under documented normalization. Three selected Redfish properties, a merely readable screen, default FRU ID, guessed URI or equality between two stale caches cannot pass. Ambiguous/duplicate mapping, missing required area/field, parse/checksum error, unauthorized blank/Not Specified value, unexplained cross-source mismatch or wrong authoritative value is FAIL. Missing Project mapping, field matrix or reference makes execution NOT READY, not Engineering Decision Pending; documented inapplicability can be N/A only with authoritative SPEC evidence.
safety_gate: Use only protected, certificate-verified read sessions and the approved IPMI interface/channel/bridge. Never place credentials on a process-visible command line or use `curl -k` as acceptance evidence.
Enumerate then bind the FRU device and API/UI member to the physical adapter using the approved Project mapping; do not assume FRU ID 0, a resource name, first member or similar serial string.
Permit only `fru` enumeration and `fru print` reads. Prohibit FRU write/edit/upgEkey, raw Storage writes, inventory refresh actions, log clearing, reset, reboot and power operations.
Preserve raw values before normalization; normalization may handle only approved encoding, padding, blank and truncation rules and must never hide a true part/serial/asset mismatch.
Retain actual WebUI visual evidence. Redfish JSON, HTML source or a synthesized report cannot replace the source-required rendered UI table/detail.
Redact serial, asset and board identifiers in reports while retaining stable tokens/hashes and protected originals sufficient for field-by-field audit; stop on target or authority ambiguity.
expected_evidence: Immutable SUT/BMC/adapter identity, approved FRU_ADP physical map, complete enumerated FRU device list and selected IPMI FRU ID/interface/channel metadata
Complete timestamped `ipmitool fru print <approved-FRU-ID>` output, exit status and any parser/checksum diagnostics, with protected raw artifact hash
Complete mapped Redfish Chassis/Assembly or approved OEM record, discovered links, schema/firmware identity, certificate-validation result and raw artifact hash
Actual WebUI Inventory and LEDs FRU_ADP table/detail screenshots or recording with timestamps, stable target token and all applicable fields visible
Field matrix showing area, source label, raw value, normalized value, authority, expected value and PASS/FAIL/NOT READY outcome for every applicable field
Pre/post read-only fingerprints, preserved SEL/audit evidence, explicit no-write/no-clear/no-reset/no-power proof and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is intended. On wrong target/device, ambiguous member mapping, authentication/certificate failure, parse/checksum error, stale cache or cross-source disagreement, stop, preserve and redact evidence, close sessions and obtain the missing authoritative mapping/reference. Do not write or reinitialize FRU, clear logs, reset BMC, reboot or power-cycle to force agreement, and do not automatically retry against another FRU device.

source_conflict.reason: The Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require FRU_ADP correctness with an explicit WebUI-to-ipmitool comparison. DeepSeek's omitted interfaces are an incomplete review recommendation, not conflicting Master requirements.

blocked.reason: The read-only purpose, required interfaces and correctness model are clear. Device/resource mapping, field applicability and authoritative values are finite Project execution inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Target BMC/adapter; physical-to-IPMI FRU ID and UI/API member map; interface/channel; applicable FRU areas/fields; normalization rules; authoritative BOM/manufacturing values; WebUI field map; freshness and redaction policy.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; READ-ONLY FRU_ADP PARITY REVIEW ONLY; NO IPMI, REDFISH, WEBUI OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED

external_authorities.application: Defines Chassis and Assembly inventory semantics; Assembly includes part, serial, manufacturer, production date and original-data access, while OEM mapping remains Project-specific.

project_authority: The Project/vendor package must identify the physical adapter, IPMI FRU device, supported Redfish/OEM resource, field applicability and authoritative expected values. Once supplied, the complete comparison is deterministic and read-only and requires no point-of-action confirmation.
